object.attr: stakeholder: dates are compared in this form, and 2026-02-30 isn't a date. Other ISO 8601 forms, such as 20260210 or 2026-W06-2, don't fit; the test cases try each form CF-C19 lists (review Q23, Q43).
object.description: If an object's non-blank value for a date attribute isn't ten ASCII characters YYYY-MM-DD naming a Gregorian date from 0001-01-01 to 9999-12-31, Mellon shall report the validation error ATTR_BAD_DATE.
